newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Ecuador oil pipeline running normally - official.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador oil pipeline running normally - official.

text.p: The TransEcuador oil pipeline which transports almost all of Ecuador's crude oil production was running normally on Wednesday despite a general strike in the country, a pipeline official.
"The pipeline is working 100 percent. We are pumping normally and hoping to pump 320,000 barrels today," an operations manager for SOTE, the pipeline operator, told Reuters by telephone.
He said exports were also uninterrupted, and one ship was currently loading at the Pacific port of Palao.
It was reported earlier that Ecuadorian oil industry unions intended to join the 48-hour general strike.
In 1996, Ecuador produced an average of 383,858 barrels per day of crude.
